description: Single-label classification of mental health-related text into five categories using Azure Language Studio Custom Text Classification.

categories.name: Anxiety
categories.description: Text expressing generalized anxiety, worry, panic, nervousness, or excessive fear about everyday situations.

categories.name: Depression
categories.description: Text expressing persistent sadness, hopelessness, loss of interest, fatigue, or low mood.

categories.name: PTSD
categories.description: Text expressing trauma-related distress, flashbacks, hypervigilance, nightmares, or avoidance behaviours.

categories.name: Social_Anxiety_Disorder
categories.description: Text expressing fear of social situations, social withdrawal, fear of judgment, or social evaluation anxiety.

categories.name: Suicidal_Ideation_and_Behaviour
categories.description: Text expressing thoughts of self-harm, suicidal ideation, desire to end life, or hopelessness about the future.
